title: Stacked release-card screenshots with pricing callouts and deprecation timeline
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a set of release screenshots and quickstart visuals that demonstrate a stacked card treatment for new model launches and deprecation notices. The deliverables should prioritize legibility at small sizes, clear pricing callouts tied to each card variant (hosted / dedicated / private), and a compact deprecation timeline ribbon. These assets will be used in release notes, the docs quickstart, and the onboarding modal inside the Console. Focus on modular assets that can be shuffled (stacked, carousel, single card) to match different marketing and product placements.
screens: stacked_cards_desktop_3-up_pricing_badges.png - desktop 1200x720, three stacked cards, highlight: new model badge + per-token microprice
stacked_cards_mobile_carousel_pricing.png - mobile 360x780, swipe carousel variant with compact price chip
card_single_expanded_deprecation_ribbon.png - expanded card showing deprecation ribbon and timeline tooltip
card_compact_variant_quantized_label.png - compact tile with quantization/latency indicators and price delta
screenshot_release_notes_banner.png - wide banner combining card stack + call-to-action for migration guide
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported at required sizes: desktop, tablet, mobile
Pricing callouts show three tiers (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) with sample per-token values and tooltip copy
Deprecation ribbon includes date, 'migration guide' CTA, and a short reason summary
Accessible color contrast for badges and ribbons (WCAG AA) verified
Figma file includes named components and an export-ready frame for each screenshot
